title: Advance a configuration by a word
statement: Given a configuration of a machine with $k$ work tapes, a work-tape index $i<k$, a finite word $w$, and a state $q$, define a new configuration with state $q$. On tape $i$, the cells from its current head position through the next $|w|$ positions are replaced by the symbols of $w$ in order, and that tape's head is moved forward by $|w|$; all other tape contents and head positions, as well as the input-head position and output, are unchanged.
hypotheses_covered: a finite word over the tape alphabet
